Game Overview

2 Player BlockMiner Escape is a two-player title where race through a perilous mine with Steve and Alex, evading obstacles and spiders in a thrilling bid to escape a massive zombie. Strategically use jumps and double-jumps to outmaneuver danger, collect treasures, and reach the gold chest. Can you ensure their safety before it's too late?
